decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened too late. TXN-007904 (HARBOUR GADGETS, MER-000023, 141300 minor units EUR) is on card CRD-000193 and posted on 2026-06-13. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 135 days after posting. Policy time-limits allows 120 days from posting and says a later dispute is declined even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. Under rule-order, the time limit is checked first and decides the case before the unauthorised-transaction rules are applied. For context only: authorisation AUTH-008113 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and fraud flag set. Without the time limit, these values would have pointed to an unauthorised card-not-present payment. The card has no other transactions at this merchant; TXN-007904 is the only one. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 135 days after the charge posted on 2026-06-13. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, so we cannot accept this one.
